rules.name: k_swap
rules.expr: ok and called("swap") and wide(post("reserve0")) * post("reserve1") < wide(pre("reserve0")) * pre("reserve1")

rules.name: k_family
rules.why: constant product never shrinks on swaps

rules.name: lp_value_monotone
rules.expr: ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("reserve0")) * post("reserve1") * pre("totalSupply") * pre("totalSupply") < wide(pre("reserve0")) * pre("reserve1") * post("totalSupply") * post("totalSupply")
rules.why: k per LP share squared never drops

rules.name: r0_per_share_mintburn
rules.expr: ok and (called("mint") or called("burn")) and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("reserve0")) * pre("totalSupply") < wide(pre("reserve0")) * post("totalSupply")
rules.why: token0 per share not diluted by mint/burn

rules.name: r1_per_share_mintburn
rules.expr: ok and (called("mint") or called("burn")) and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("reserve1")) * pre("totalSupply") < wide(pre("reserve1")) * post("totalSupply")
rules.why: token1 per share not diluted by mint/burn

rules.name: burn_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("burn") and wide(ret) * pre("totalSupply") > wide(pre("balanceOf", A0)) * pre("TokenC08_TKA.balanceOf", A0)
rules.why: burn pays at most pro-rata token0

rules.name: burn_clears
rules.expr: ok and called("burn") and (post("balanceOf", A0) != 0 or post("totalSupply") + pre("balanceOf", A0) != pre("totalSupply"))
rules.why: burn burns exactly the pair-held LP

rules.name: reserves_synced
rules.expr: ok and (called("mint") or called("burn") or called("swap") or called("sync")) and (post("reserve0") != post("TokenC08_TKA.balanceOf", A0) or post("reserve1") != post("TokenC08_TKB.balanceOf", A0))
rules.why: reserves equal balances after state-changing calls

rules.name: skim_keeps_reserves
rules.expr: ok and called("skim") and (post("reserve0") != pre("reserve0") or post("reserve1") != pre("reserve1") or post("TokenC08_TKA.balanceOf", A0) != post("reserve0") or post("TokenC08_TKB.balanceOf", A0) != post("reserve1"))

rules.name: swap_to

params.forbidden: arg(2) == A1 or arg(2) == A2 or (arg(0) == 0 and arg(1) == 0) or arg(0) >= pre("reserve0") or arg(1) >= pre("reserve1")

rules.why: cannot send to token contracts; needs output

rules.name: swap_supply
rules.expr: ok and called("swap") and post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply")

rules.name: transfer_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("transfer") and arg(0) != sender and (post("balanceOf", sender) + arg(1) != pre("balanceOf", sender) or post("balanceOf", arg(0)) != pre("balanceOf", arg(0)) + arg(1))

rules.name: transfer_no_reserves
rules.expr: ok and called("transfer") and (post("reserve0") != pre("reserve0") or post("reserve1") != pre("reserve1") or post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply"))

rules.name: lp_third_party
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and post("balanceOf", u) < pre("balanceOf", u)
rules.why: nobody loses LP in others' calls

rules.name: tokens_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("mint") or called("burn") or called("swap") or called("skim") or called("sync") or called("transfer")) and u != sender and u != A0 and (post("TokenC08_TKA.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC08_TKA.balanceOf", u) or post("TokenC08_TKB.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC08_TKB.balanceOf", u))
rules.why: pair calls never take users' tokens

rules.name: first_mint_min
rules.expr: ok and called("mint") and pre("totalSupply") == 0 and post("balanceOf", 57005) != 1000

rules.name: mint_needs_input
rules.expr: ok and called("mint") and post("reserve0") <= pre("reserve0") and post("reserve1") <= pre("reserve1")
